entries.zh: 空白簿册；尚未书写的本子
entries.en: blank book; empty ledger or notebook

entries.zh: 城志；记载城池事务的志书
entries.en: city chronicle; record book of the city

entries.zh: 志书；地方志（誌書）
entries.en: gazetteer; local chronicle
entries.notes: M 栏末音节 chū 无对应汉字，疑为衍文或脱字。

entries.zh: 籍册；供诵读的常用书本
entries.en: ordinary book; register or reader
entries.notes: L 栏 eng leen 疑为 en que leen 之讹省，义据 籍 与 M chēc 推定。

entries.zh: 典籍；经史要籍
entries.en: classics; canonical books
entries.notes: 同上条，L 栏 en que leen 讹省，义据 典籍 定。

entries.zh: 祈祷诵念用书；虔修读本
entries.en: devotional book; prayer book
entries.notes: L 栏残损、M 栏音写不可解，仅据 devocion 与 簿 推其大略。

entries.zh: 《明心宝鉴》——劝善格言集，马尼拉华人伦理读本；取「人心之镜」义
entries.en: the Mingxin Baojian ("Precious Mirror for Enlightening the Mind"), a Chinese moral anthology; mirror of all human wisdom
entries.notes: L 栏末字缺损（humana _），espejo de toda humana [sabiduría] 与「宝鉴」义合。

entries.zh: 登记簿；门户、户籍登记册
entries.en: register book; gate or household register

entries.zh: 书信范本；教人写书信的尺牍书
entries.en: letter-writer; book teaching how to write letters
entries.notes: H 束 当为 柬，据 M cān（kán）推之。

entries.zh: 帖式；书信文书的格式范本
entries.en: model letter forms; epistolary formulary

entries.zh: 帖文；文书范本
entries.en: document text; model document

entries.zh: 账簿；记数备忘之簿
entries.en: memorandum book; account or tally book

entries.zh: 教理书籍；劝善弘道之书
entries.en: book of good doctrine; religious instruction book
entries.notes: L 栏 devchorica 疑为 evangélica 之讹，H 文書 系书籍泛称。

entries.zh: 族谱；家世谱系之书
entries.en: genealogy; family lineage register

entries.zh: 妖书；巫术符咒之书
entries.en: book of sorcery; witchcraft book

entries.zh: 票；执照、许可证
entries.en: licence; permit (written ticket)

entries.zh: 讲明；陈说清楚（用于禀告请示、致谢）
entries.en: to state clearly; to explain or inform (in asking or giving consent)
entries.notes: H 講明 偏「说明」义，与 licencia 仅部分对等，M 栏又混入西语 informar、agradecer。

entries.zh: 给付；准予发给（许可）
entries.en: to grant or issue; to hand over (a licence)
entries.notes: H 給付 指准予发给，与 beneplácito（允准）义近而未完全对等。

entries.zh: 打票；领取、申领执照
entries.en: to take out a licence; to obtain a permit

entries.zh: 禀明；向上陈报请示以求准
entries.en: to petition or report to a superior (to request a licence)

entries.zh: 儒者；学士、有科名学问的人
entries.en: licentiate; scholar (Confucian literate)

entries.zh: 春元；对有科名者（举人一类）的敬称
entries.en: honorific for a degree-holder; provincial graduate
entries.notes: L 栏 zigrado 疑为 graduado 之讹；春元 所指科名等第未详。
